## Match baby names to dogs
This step uses `dogs_prepared` from dog-names.qmd and `ssa_reference` from baby-names.qmd in the same R session. Use all complete decades in the reference. Keep a separate yes/no result for each decade so a name can match several generations. `left_join()` keeps every dog and adds the reference columns for its name. Unmatched names receive missing lookup values. `across()` applies the same helper to each recognition/decade column: `missing_means_false()` uses `replace_na(FALSE)` to turn missing matches into FALSE while preserving existing TRUE/FALSE results. The helper is defined in `helpers.R`.
```{r}
#| label: match-dogs-to-baby-names
dogs_prepared |>
  left_join(ssa_reference, by = "name") |>
  mutate(across(c(ssa_recognized, starts_with("top100_")), missing_means_false)) ->
  dogs

dogs |>
  select(name, ssa_recognized, starts_with("top100_")) |>
  preview()
```
